text: The model flagged the applicant as high‑risk because the strongest driver was a very high revolving‑credit utilization. At a utilization rate of about 76 %, the model added roughly 0.91 points to the default probability, indicating that the borrower is using most of the credit available to them. The applicant’s age of 40 also nudged the risk upward, contributing an additional 0.24 points. The only factor that pulled the score down was the absence of any 30‑to‑59‑day past‑due accounts, which reduced the risk by about 0.15 points. When the large positive contributions from utilization and age outweigh the small negative impact from clean recent payment history, the overall probability rises to 50.5 %, leading the model to label the loan as high risk.
